name: io.github.aspekt19/loyal-spark
title: Loyal Spark
description: 43 MCP tools for onchain loyalty on Base: programs, minting, rewards, vouchers. x402 or lsk_ key.

tools.name: get_platform_info
tools.description: Get info about Loyal Spark protocol on Base L2

tools.name: get_my_profile
tools.description: Get authenticated agent's profile, plan limits, and current-period usage

tools.name: get_payment_info
tools.description: Free: agent Pro/Enterprise (or merchant) plan options, USDC subscription wallet, per-plan limits, annual prices, and the required-sender rule. Optional product=agent|merchant. Prefer this before paying; verify with POST /verify-agent-plan-payment action verify_payment.

tools.name: generate_program_defaults
tools.description: Workflow planner: field catalog, required parameters, next_actions, and non-binding examples. External agents must choose their own name, symbol, and economics.

business_name.description: Optional merchant / brand name for example suggestions

description.description: Optional short business description for examples

locale.description: Optional locale/language hint for example names (e.g. en, ru)

preferred_style.description: Optional naming style hint for examples (e.g. playful, premium)

target_audience.description: Optional audience hint for examples (e.g. locals, tourists)

tools.name: get_program_workflow_status
tools.description: Explain the next merchant action: current_step, required fields, and ordered next_actions (you provide all parameter values)

tools.name: list_loyalty_programs
tools.description: List loyalty programs owned by the agent's merchant

tools.name: create_loyalty_program
tools.description: Get factory calldata to deploy a new loyalty token on Base. Defaults to B20 (Base-native B20 asset standard, ERC-20 compatible, single tx, active immediately). Pass token_standard='erc20' for the legacy factory. For B20, MINT_ROLE is granted atomically to the merchant admin AND to the agent's CDP wallet (or explicit extra_minters) so autonomous agents can mint with no follow-up transaction.

symbol.description: Token symbol, 2-5 chars (required for external agents)

token_standard.description: 'b20' (default, single-tx deploy on Base precompile factory) or 'erc20' (legacy factory, requires activate_loyalty_program follow-up)

agent_wallet_address.description: (B20 only) Additional wallet to grant MINT_ROLE atomically. Defaults to the agent's active CDP MPC wallet if not provided.

extra_minters.description: (B20 only) Extra addresses to grant MINT_ROLE atomically in the same deploy tx.

auto_generate.description: Internal automation only — fills missing name/symbol from examples. External agents should pass explicit name and symbol.

preferred_style.description: Optional naming style hint when auto_generate fills examples

locale.description: Optional locale/language hint for auto_generate examples

target_audience.description: Optional audience hint for auto_generate examples

tools.name: register_loyalty_program
tools.description: Register a deployed token as a loyalty program in the database. B20 tokens are registered as active; legacy ERC-20 as inactive (activate next).

cashback_rate.description: Default cashback percent for earn (1–100). Omit for DB default (5).

points_per_dollar.description: Loyalty points per $1 spent (1–1000). Omit for DB default (1).

tools.name: activate_loyalty_program
tools.description: For legacy ERC-20 programs: returns unpauseUtility + enableMinting calldata. For B20 programs: no-op (already active).

tools.name: update_program_status
tools.description: Update program status in database after onchain activation/pause

status.description: New status: active, paused, or inactive

tools.name: update_program_config
tools.description: Update default cashback_rate and/or points_per_dollar for a program (same as merchant dashboard sliders)

cashback_rate.description: New default cashback % for earn (1–100). Omit to leave unchanged.

points_per_dollar.description: New points per $1 (0–1000, exclusive 0). Omit to leave unchanged.

tools.name: list_rewards
tools.description: List rewards for a loyalty program by token_address. Includes redemption metrics (total vouchers issued, redeemed, and last-30-day counts) for each reward.

tools.name: create_reward
tools.description: Create a new reward redeemable with loyalty tokens

tools.name: mint_loyalty_tokens
tools.description: Record a mint intent and get a fee-first calls[] bundle: protocol fee mint first (in the merchant's own loyalty tokens, not USDC), then the recipient mint. Submit both in order (atomically via EIP-5792 if supported), then call confirm_mint_fee with obligation_id, fee_tx_hash, recipient_tx_hash. Unconfirmed fees block future mints. recipient_address takes a 0x Base wallet or a customer email (or use recipient_email); the wallet is resolved server-side.

recipient_address.description: Customer 0x Base wallet address or customer email receiving minted tokens. Preferred — matches REST.

recipient.description: Legacy alias for recipient_address (0x address or email)

recipient_email.description: Customer email address to resolve to their Base wallet

tools.name: transfer_loyalty_tokens
tools.description: Build B20 token transfer calldata (ERC-20 compatible) to send loyalty tokens from your merchant wallet to any 0x address. Recipient: to (alias to_address).

to_address.description: Alias for to (same as REST POST /transfer to_address)

tools.name: earn_points
tools.description: Mint cashback tokens for a purchase at the program's cashback rate, optionally redeeming points first (points_to_redeem or redeem_all) to lower the payable amount. Returns a fee-first calls[] bundle (protocol fee mint, then the customer mint): submit in order (atomically via EIP-5792 if supported), then call confirm_mint_fee with obligation_id, fee_tx_hash, recipient_tx_hash. Unconfirmed fees block future mints.

purchase_amount.description: Purchase amount in currency units (e.g. dollars)

cashback_rate.description: Override cashback rate (%). If omitted, uses the program's default rate.

points_to_redeem.description: Optional integer loyalty points to redeem at the counter to reduce purchase_amount.

redeem_all.description: If true, redeems all available customer loyalty points (up to purchase_amount when positive).

tools.name: confirm_mint_fee
tools.description: Confirm a prepared mint on Base. Verifies the protocol-fee mint and, when recipient_tx_hash is set (or the fee receipt already contains the recipient mint), writes customer_tier_status so get_token_balance leaves 0. Same hash for both fields when EIP-5792 batched the calls. A second call with recipient_tx_hash still credits the customer after the fee is already settled.

obligation_id.description: fee_obligation_id returned by mint_loyalty_tokens or earn_points

fee_tx_hash.description: Transaction hash of the protocol fee mint

recipient_tx_hash.description: Transaction hash of the mint to the recipient. Same as fee_tx_hash when both mints are in one transaction. Required to update GET /balance.

mint_intent_id.description: Optional mint_intent_id from the mint response; links this exact intent when several pending mints share token, recipient and amount.

tools.name: list_mints
tools.description: List mint intents for this merchant. status=pending means transaction_hash is still null (confirm has not credited the recipient). status=completed means the recipient mint was recorded. GET /balance offchain_ledger_balance stays 0 until confirm.

tools.name: list_fee_obligations
tools.description: List protocol-fee obligations for this API key. status=unpaid is an alias for pending. Each unpaid row includes next_action describing POST /mint/confirm.

tools.name: get_token_balance
tools.description: Get loyalty token balance and tier info for a customer (accepts 0x Base wallet address or customer email in customer_address / customer_email)

customer_address.description: Customer 0x Base wallet address or customer email

tools.name: get_program_analytics
tools.description: Get analytics for one of your loyalty programs. total_customers is the same count export_customers and GET /customers report; a program you do not own returns program_not_found.

tools.name: list_marketplace_offers
tools.description: List active token trading offers on the marketplace

token_address.description: Optional. When set, only offers that give or ask for this token.

tools.name: redeem_reward
tools.description: Redeem a reward by providing a verified token transfer transaction hash. Creates a voucher for the customer.

reward_id.description: UUID of the reward to redeem

customer_address.description: Wallet address of the customer who transferred tokens

transaction_hash.description: Onchain tx hash of the token transfer from customer to merchant

tools.name: use_voucher
tools.description: Mark a voucher as used at the merchant. Send one of voucher_code (alias code) or voucher_id (anyOf). If neither is sent the tool returns error_code missing_identifier and an example. A voucher used before returns error_code voucher_already_used (do not retry).

voucher_code.description: Voucher code (LOYAL-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX). Use this OR voucher_id.

voucher_id.description: Voucher UUID. Use this OR voucher_code.

tools.name: check_voucher_status
tools.description: Check voucher status for this merchant. Send one of code, voucher_code, or voucher_id (anyOf). If none is sent the tool returns error_code missing_identifier, an example, and next_action. Anonymous public lookup is GET /agent-api/vouchers/status.

code.description: Voucher code (LOYAL-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX). One of code, voucher_code, or voucher_id is required.

voucher_id.description: Voucher UUID. One of code, voucher_code, or voucher_id is required.

voucher_code.description: Alias of code. One of code, voucher_code, or voucher_id is required.

tools.name: create_personalized_offer
tools.description: Create a personalized offer for a specific customer. Use when analytics reveal engagement patterns (e.g., inactive customers, high-value segments).

valid_days.description: How many days the offer is valid (default: 7)

tools.name: update_reward_status
tools.description: Activate or deactivate a reward in the catalog. Use to manage reward availability based on analytics.

is_active.description: true to activate, false to deactivate

tools.name: send_report
tools.description: Internal. Send a report to the merchant's Agent Reports dashboard (SEO audits, growth ideas, anomalies, weekly summaries). Not a loyalty action.

agent_role.description: Your role: ceo, seo, growth, or analyst

report_type.description: One of: seo_audit, audit, growth_idea, data_report, anomaly, task, recommendation, weekly_report. Anything else is rejected (400 invalid_input), not renamed.

priority.description: Priority: low, medium, high, or critical

tools.name: list_my_reports
tools.description: Internal. List reports this agent submitted (status new, reviewed, or done).

status.description: Filter by status: new, reviewed, done (optional)

tools.name: update_report_status
tools.description: Internal. Set a report you submitted to reviewed or done.

tools.name: delete_report
tools.description: Internal. Delete a report you submitted.

report_id.description: UUID of the report to delete

tools.name: export_customers
tools.description: Export customers of one of your loyalty programs: the same wallet set and total_customers as GET /customers and get_program_analytics (voucher holders, ledger rows, completed mints), each with voucher stats, on-chain current_balance plus offchain_ledger_balance, and tier. Email-only store customers are listed in store_customers.

token_address.description: Token address of the loyalty program

tools.name: list_store_discount_codes
tools.description: List discount codes for this merchant's Shopify store, plus how customers spend points (online code, register voucher, or both).

token_address.description: Program address. Omit to list every linked store.

tools.name: update_store_discount_code
tools.description: Mark a Shopify discount code used, or cancel it and return the loyalty points. Same actions as the merchant discount-code journal.

tools.name: set_store_sales_channel
tools.description: Set how this store's customers spend loyalty points: online (checkout code), offline (voucher at the register), or both (the shopper chooses).

tools.name: create_gift_certificate
tools.description: Create a gift / welcome certificate (UDS-style) with a unique random redemption code (LOYAL-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX). Customer redeems via QR or by entering the code; merchant then mints tokens on-chain. Use for welcome bonuses, promo campaigns, partnership gifts.

token_address.description: ERC-20 loyalty token address (must belong to the agent's merchant)

points_per_dollar.description: Optional override of program rate (e.g. 10 = 10 tokens per $1). Defaults to program's points_per_dollar.

max_redemption_percent.description: Max % of any future purchase the customer can pay with these tokens (5–100). Default 50.

description.description: Optional descriptive text shown to the customer

expires_in_days.description: Validity period in days (omit for no expiry)

image_url.description: Optional public image URL for the cert design

quantity.description: Number of certificates to create as a batch (1–100, default 1)

tools.name: list_gift_certificates
tools.description: List gift certificates issued by the agent's merchant (with status and redemption info).

status.description: Filter by status: active, pending_mint, redeemed, expired, revoked

tools.name: revoke_gift_certificate
tools.description: Revoke an active gift certificate (status active -> revoked). Only the issuing merchant can revoke. Already-redeemed/minted certificates cannot be revoked.

certificate_id.description: UUID of the certificate from create_gift_certificate / list_gift_certificates

tools.name: mark_gift_certificate_minted
tools.description: After the merchant submits the on-chain mint transaction for a claimed gift certificate, call this to mark it as minted (status pending_mint -> redeemed) and store the mint tx hash.

tools.name: bazaar_discover_resources
tools.description: Discover third-party x402-paid resources published in Coinbase CDP's Bazaar (docs, data feeds, AI inference, etc). Read-only. Filter by free-text q and/or network (e.g. 'base').

q.description: Free-text filter matched against the resource JSON (name/description/url)

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous call

tools.name: bazaar_discover_mcp_servers
tools.description: Search Coinbase CDP's Bazaar MCP catalog (search_resources) for third-party x402-payable tools. Read-only, free. Rows are run via the Bazaar MCP server's proxy_tool_call, not here.

cursor.description: Ignored: CDP search has no cursor. Narrow with q/network.

tools.name: bazaar_probe_x402
tools.description: Probe one x402 resource URL without paying: a single GET (https only, 5 s, 64 KB, no redirects). If it answers HTTP 402, returns a parsed summary of the x402 payment requirements (PAYMENT-REQUIRED header or accepts[]). Any other status returns error not_x402_resource with the status only: the response body is never returned. No signing. No API key needed: keyless calls are limited to 20/minute per IP; with a key the key's own limits apply.

url.description: Full https:// URL of the x402-paid endpoint

tools.name: bazaar_pay_and_call
tools.description: Pay a Loyal Spark x402 URL on api.loyalspark.online with the merchant agent's CDP MPC wallet (EIP-3009 exact scheme, Base USDC). Other hosts are refused before any signature. Requires scope 'mint' and an active CDP wallet. max_usdc default 0.25, hard limit 10.

url.description: Full https:// URL of the x402 resource

body.description: Optional JSON request body for non-GET methods

max_usdc.description: Spend cap for THIS call in USDC (default 0.25, must be ≤ 10)
